inputs.prompt:
Locate and transcribe every readable line of text in the image. Return a single JSON array in natural reading order.

Each element follows this schema:
`{"bbox": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], "text": "string"}`

Rules:
1. Use line-level annotations. Each element must represent exactly one visible line of text; keep the words of one line together and do not merge separate lines.
2. The bbox coordinates are integers scaled to [0, 1000).
3. Each bbox must tightly enclose its line.
4. Preserve the original text exactly without translation, paraphrasing, correction, or completion.
5. Output strictly valid JSON only. Do not output Markdown, explanations, or code fences.

_meta.title: Read every text line with its box (instruction)
Lines + boxes as JSON text: [{"bbox":[x0,y0,x1,y1] in 0-1000, "text":"..."}]

workflows.licence: n/a (no model; ComfyUI core + VideoHelperSuite loader)

cpuRuns.settings: 6 s stereo 44.1 kHz clip -> 20 s, crossfade 1 s
cpuRuns.result: FLAC 20.000 s, 44.1 kHz stereo (music not resampled), no clicks (max sample step = typical), seams at 5/10/15 s, fade-out over the last second

workflows.notes: audio2 = the crossfade curve the provider writes: a stereo WAV exactly crossfade seconds long, left = sin(pi/2 t) fade-in, right = cos(pi/2 t) fade-out, at a low rate (8 kHz) so AudioMerge upsamples the curve, never the music. Core has no gain-ramp node, hence the uploaded curve. Repeats = ceil((duration - crossfade)/(clip - crossfade)) from VHS_LoadAudioUpload's duration; each repeat is body + (tail fading out + head fading in). headroomDb (default -3) keeps the summed seam below 1.0 because AudioMerge 'add' normalises a whole segment when it peaks over 1. A pure tone shows a +3 dB bump at the seams (equal power on correlated sound); write a linear curve instead for loops of very similar material. Clip must be longer than 2 x crossfade. ACE-Step beds (<=240 s) become 10-minute beds.

workflows.title: Reference video to a style brief (Gemma 4 E4B reads frames + sound, core TextGenerate)

inputs.prompt: You are given a short-form reference video (frames at 1 fps plus its soundtrack). Write a reusable style brief for a new faceless video in the same style. Return strict JSON with keys: format (e.g. 'what if' explainer), hook (first 3 s), pacing (average shot length in seconds), shots (list of {seconds, visual, camera, on_screen_text}), visual_style (medium, palette, lighting, texture), animation_style (one of 'Fully animated', 'Frame by frame', 'Scene by scene video', 'Seamless motion video'), narration (voice, tone, words per minute, language), music (genre, energy), captions (style, position), and topic_ideas (5). Describe style only; never copy the reference's people, logos or exact words.

workflows.notes: Added by the round-4 critic for Content Factory's 'Use as reference'. VHS_LoadVideo resamples to 24 fps (TextGenerate assumes 24 fps and keeps every 24th frame, i.e. 1 fps; gemma4.py caps a video frame at 70 soft tokens) and passes the clip's sound on the same call. Default cap 720 frames = the first 30 s at 384 px wide (~0.7 GB of frames in RAM, inferred). In ComfyUI v0.41 only the Gemma 4 and MiniMax text encoders read a video input; the Qwen3.5 encoder (OvisOCR3, translate-qwen35-textgen) ignores it. The instruction asks for a style brief as JSON (format, hook, pacing, shots, visual and animation style, narration, music, captions, topic ideas) and forbids copying people, logos or words. Whether Gemma 4 E4B accepts 30 s of audio in one call is unverified.

existingWorkflowRuns.result: 99 frames at 50 fps, 1.98 s, sound kept (N frames -> 2N-1)

newModels.name: Lip-sync and 3D
newModels.vsCurrentPick: No new open lip-sync model with ComfyUI support was found (HF searches 'lipsync', 'talking'; only ONNX/CoreML ports and MuseTalk fine-tunes). New 3D repos (UniForge3D cc-by-nc-4.0, Hi3D, MeshAxiom) have no ComfyUI support; MoGe 3 (template 2026-09-18) estimates geometry, it does not make assets. CRITIC CORRECTION 2026-10-22: MoGe does make assets. Core MoGePointMapToMesh + SaveGLB turn its point map into a textured whole-scene GLB (template 3d_moge_perspective_to_mesh, 2026-05-15; MoGe 3 via utility_moge3_geometry_estimation, 2026-09-18, MIT); it ran here on CPU (scene-mesh-moge). Core also has native TripoSplat image-to-Gaussian-splat nodes (template 2026-06-02, MIT + DINOv3 License). Both fit Cinema Studio's 3D scene, which no round-4 file had an open graph for.
newModels.verdict: Lip-sync: InfiniteTalk / LatentSync stay. 3D: TRELLIS.2 stays for assets; add scene-mesh-moge (whole scene) and image-to-splat-triposplat (subject splat).

criticCheck.revalidation: All 14 round-4 graphs re-posted to POST /prompt on the live CPU ComfyUI v0.41 (fc04da91) by an independent script (own Sleep blocker, zero-byte placeholders for missing weights, fixtures from scripts/comfy/fixtures, queue entries deleted, placeholders and fixtures removed): 14/14 accepted with no node_errors. A static check of 315 nodes against /object_info found no unknown class or input, except VHS_VideoCombine's 'profile', which VHS adds per format at run time.
criticCheck.fpsTargets: FrameInterpolate takes an integer multiplier 2-16. For Higgsfield's exact FPS Boost targets interpolate by m, then keep every n-th frame (VHS_SelectEveryNthImage) with src*m/n = target: 24->30 m5 n4; 24->60 m5 n2; 24->90 m15 n4; 24->120 m5 n1; 30->60 m2; 30->90 m3; 30->120 m4; 60->90 m3 n2; 60->120 m2. Not built or timed.
criticCheck.depthColormaps: The installed VideoDepthAnythingOutput offers only 'gray' and 'inferno'; MoGeRender offers 'depth' and 'depth_colored'. Higgsfield's Turbo / Magma / Viridis need a LUT step (not researched).
